notes: Ad placement mechanics learned issue #8: the beehiiv ad network allows only ONE 'primary' ad slot per post (extra primaries are rejected with 'No primary ad slot is available'), and the publication already had its full allotment of ACCEPTED opportunities, so placing fresh offers from list_ad_offers failed with 'can not accept any more opportunities'. Fix: embed the already-accepted opportunity IDs from list_ad_opportunities(status=accepted) directly, with the highest-value ad as the single 'primary' and the rest as 'secondary'. Offer IDs from list_ad_offers rotate every call; accepted opportunity IDs are stable.
